mapper.select: SELECT TITLE , VIEW_COUNT , POST_NO FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM RNUM, A.* FROM ( SELECT POST_NO , TITLE , VIEW_COUNT FROM BOARD_POST WHERE POST_TYPE = 'NOTICE' AND STATUS = 'Y' ORDER BY POST_NO DESC ) A ) WHERE RNUM <= 8
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_POST WHERE POST_TYPE = 'NEWS' AND STATUS = 'Y'

SELECT POST_NO , TITLE , VIEW_COUNT , FILE_PATH || SAVE_NAME AS "TITLEIMG" , B.CREATED_AT FROM BOARD_POST B JOIN FILE_ATTACHMENT ON (POST_NO = TARGET_NO) WHERE POST_TYPE = 'NEWS' AND B.STATUS = 'Y' AND FILE_LEVEL = 1 ORDER BY POST_NO DESC
SELECT POST_NO , CATEGORY , TITLE , USER_NAME , B.CREATED_AT , CONTENT FROM BOARD_POST B JOIN MEMBER ON (WRITER_NO = USER_NO) WHERE POST_NO = #{postNo}
SELECT FILE_NO , ORIGIN_NAME , SAVE_NAME , FILE_PATH FROM FILE_ATTACHMENT WHERE TARGET_NO = #{postNo} ORDER BY FILE_NO ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_POST WHERE POST_TYPE = 'NOTICE'

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT A.*, ROWNUM FROM ( SELECT POST_NO , TITLE , USER_NAME , B.CREATED_AT , B.STATUS FROM BOARD_POST B JOIN MEMBER ON (WRITER_NO = USER_NO) WHERE POST_TYPE = 'NOTICE' ORDER BY POST_NO ) A ) ORDER BY ROWNUM DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_POST WHERE POST_TYPE = 'NOTICE' AND TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT A.*, ROWNUM FROM ( SELECT POST_NO , TITLE , USER_NAME , B.CREATED_AT , B.STATUS FROM BOARD_POST B JOIN MEMBER ON (WRITER_NO = USER_NO) WHERE POST_TYPE = 'NOTICE' AND TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ORDER BY POST_NO ) A ) ORDER BY ROWNUM DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOARD_POST(POST_NO , POST_TYPE , CATEGORY , TITLE , CONTENT , CREATED_AT , WRITER_NO) VALUES(SEQ_POST_NO.NEXTVAL , 'NOTICE' , 'NOTICE' , #{title} , #{content} , SYSDATE , #{postWriter})

INSERT INTO FILE_ATTACHMENT(FILE_NO , TARGET_NO , TARGET_TYPE , ORIGIN_NAME , SAVE_NAME , FILE_PATH) VALUES(SEQ_FILE_NO.NEXTVAL , SEQ_POST_NO.CURRVAL , 'NOTICE' , #{originName} , #{saveName} , #{filePath})
